clue.text: Fodder a number eat

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five, a number
to etch is to eat away at a surface, as acid does

explanation.surface: Someone tells a herd of animals to tuck into their feed.
explanation.definitionFit: Vetch is a leguminous plant grown as cattle feed, so it is a kind of fodder.

clue.text: Champion pursued by press —- old writer

parts.note: a victor is a winner or champion
to hug someone is to press them close

explanation.surface: A winning athlete is chased by reporters, an elderly author among them.
explanation.walkthrough: The dash makes 'old writer' look like a phrase, but 'old' gives O and 'writer' alone defines this French novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Victor Hugo was the French writer of Les Misérables, so he is an example of a writer.

clue.text: Make black and blue or brown

definitions.meaning: to beat or thrash someone, leaving bruises
a light brown colour, as skin gets in the sun

explanation.definitionFit: Tan means to thrash, as in tanning someone's hide, and is also a light brown shade.

clue.text: Henry joins crew for summit

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
a rowing eight is a crew of eight oarsmen

explanation.surface: A man named Henry joins a boat team for a top-level meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: A rowing eight is a racing boat with eight rowers, so crew gives EIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Height can mean the highest point or peak, as in the height of fame, so it means summit.

clue.text: Fruit left hidden by flexible stem — it hangs straight down

parts.note: a plum is a fruit

indicators.note: one piece is hidden inside the other, so the word for left goes into the stem

parts.note: a bine is the flexible climbing stem of a plant such as the hop

explanation.surface: A piece of fruit gets lost among the tendrils of a climbing plant that dangles down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hidden by' puts L inside BINE to make BLINE.
explanation.definitionFit: A plumb line is a cord with a weight that hangs vertically, used by builders to check uprights.

clue.text: Jasper, perhaps, in place or out of place

indicators.note: out of place means the letters are moved from their positions into a new order

explanation.surface: A man named Jasper either fits in or is awkwardly out of place.
explanation.walkthrough: Jasper here is Wedgwood jasperware, a type of fine ceramic, not a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Jasperware is a fine Wedgwood ceramic, so jasper is an example of this kind of china.

clue.text: Was not accustomed to American English biblical text

parts.note: US is short for United States, so American
NT is the New Testament, a biblical text

explanation.surface: An American found it odd to read an English translation of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Usen't is an old contraction of used not, meaning was not in the habit of something.

clue.text: Criminal behaviour of gang I am judging

parts.note: a band is a gang or group
to try a case is to judge it in court

explanation.surface: A judge sizes up the misdeeds of a gang.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I am judging' reads as 'I try', so 'am' only links I to TRY.
explanation.definitionFit: Banditry is the activity of bandits, robbery and lawlessness, so it is criminal behaviour.

clue.text: Supervisor, one living unconventionally on top of a hill

indicators.note: in a down clue the first pieces sit above the last ones

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: unconventionally means in an unusual way, so these letters are put in an unexpected order

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: An overseer lives an eccentric life on a hilltop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unconventionally' makes NVIGIL; in a down entry, 'on top of' means the first part sits above the hill part.
explanation.definitionFit: An invigilator supervises candidates during an exam, so the word names a kind of supervisor.

clue.text: Cash for jumper

definitions.meaning: the European single currency is money
a type of wallaroo, an Australian kangaroo that leaps

explanation.walkthrough: The jumper here is the animal that jumps, not a pullover.
explanation.definitionFit: Euro is both Europe's currency and a name for the wallaroo, a jumping kangaroo.

clue.text: I interrupted short performance, say, coming back as caretaker

indicators.note: the letter I breaks into the middle of the shortened word, interrupting it
short means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: a concert is a musical performance

indicators.note: coming back means the abbreviation is read from right to left

parts.note: say is often used to introduce an example, as e.g. does

explanation.surface: Someone apologises for breaking into a brief show, then returns to act as a building's custodian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' leaves CONCER, which 'interrupted' splits with I; 'coming back' gives GE.
explanation.definitionFit: A concierge looks after a block of flats or a hotel entrance, acting as its caretaker or porter.

clue.text: On no account name first lady queen

parts.note: Eve was the first woman in the Bible
R stands for regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: Someone refuses outright to name the wife of a president as queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first lady' looks like a president's wife, but here it means Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: Never is an emphatic refusal, meaning not at any time and so not on any account.

clue.text: With insufficient money, things are soon out of hand

indicators.note: out of hand means out of control, so these letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: A warning that matters will soon spiral out of control.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something on a shoestring means doing it on a very small budget, with barely enough money.

clue.text: Celebration about South Africa — one pretty girl initiated

indicators.note: initiated means the girl starts things off, coming first

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: about means the adverb goes round the abbreviation for the country

parts.note: pretty can mean very, as in pretty good
RSA is the Republic of South Africa

explanation.surface: A party honours South Africa, where a beautiful young woman is being welcomed in.
explanation.walkthrough: Pretty as an adverb means fairly or very; 'about' and 'initiated' are the placement signals, giving VERSARY and putting the girl first.
explanation.definitionFit: An anniversary is a yearly occasion marked with festivities, so it is a celebration.

clue.text: Go and niggle the niggler

indicators.note: to niggle is to fret or irritate, so these letters are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is told to go on and pester the habitual pesterer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'niggle' is the anagram signal; the letters of THE NIGGLER are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A green light is permission to proceed, so it means the go-ahead, a go.

clue.text: Deer placed at the rear

definitions.meaning: a female red deer is called by this name
an adjective for something at the back, as with back legs

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a female deer and back or rear, as in its rear legs.

clue.text: One guilty of highway robbery?

parts.note: read highway as high up: a thief who climbs to upper windows and roofs to steal, rather than a robber on the road

explanation.definitionFit: A cat burglar enters buildings by climbing to high windows and roofs, so the theft is literally high up.

clue.text: Most resilient since being injured during match

indicators.note: during means the scrambled word occurs within the contest

parts.note: a bout is a boxing match

indicators.note: being injured means hurt or damaged, so the letters are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: A boxer has bounced back best even after being hurt in a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being injured' makes NCIES; 'during' is the container signal. Resilient here means springy, not tough.
explanation.definitionFit: Bounciest means most springy, so it describes whatever recovers shape best, the most resilient.

clue.text: Put one's foot down with some energy, and run

parts.note: stamped means brought one's foot down hard
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Someone stamps their foot with some force and then dashes off.
explanation.definitionFit: A stampede is a sudden mass rush, and as a verb it means to run in a panicked crowd.

clue.text: Express oneself in Bach piece check on the inner part

indicators.note: in here says the next pieces go inside the Bach piece
the inner part points to the middle of the dance's name, where the other letters go

parts.note: a gigue is a lively dance movement in Bach's suites
to vet is to check
taken as written

explanation.surface: A musician speaks up about part of a Bach dance, checking its central passage.
explanation.walkthrough: A gigue is a jig, the closing dance of a Baroque suite; 'in' and 'the inner part' place VETON in its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: To give tongue is to speak out or, of hounds, to bay, so it means to express oneself.

clue.text: Eye problem in a way —- part of eye obscured

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way

indicators.note: only part of the word remains, as one letter goes
obscured means a letter of the word is hidden from view and so dropped

parts.note: taken as written before its first letter is removed

explanation.surface: A doctor notes an eye complaint in which part of the eye is blocked from sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'part of' and 'obscured' drop the first E from EYE, leaving YE.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid, a common eye complaint.

clue.text: Cards may be receiving attention

definitions.meaning: cards held by a player, not yet played
being dealt with or under control, as a matter being handled

explanation.definitionFit: In hand describes cards one is holding and also a matter being dealt with.

clue.text: Redesigned electromotor incorporates new method of operating

indicators.note: incorporates means the scrambled letters take another letter into their body
something redesigned is rebuilt in a fresh layout, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An engineer has rebuilt an electric motor to include a novel way of running it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Redesigned' rearranges ELECTROMOTOR, and 'incorporates' puts N inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Remote control is a way of operating a machine from a distance, so it is a method of operation.

clue.text: Crowd doesn't have right beachwear

indicators.note: doesn't have means the letter is left out of the word

parts.note: a throng is a crowd

explanation.surface: A crowd at the seaside lacks proper swimming gear.
explanation.definitionFit: A thong is a skimpy swimsuit bottom or a flip-flop, both items worn on the beach.

clue.text: Not the current head cook

indicators.note: Not means the symbol is removed from the word

parts.note: a chief is a head or leader
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: The new head cook replaces the present one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the current' reads as the present one, but it is I, the symbol for current in physics.
explanation.definitionFit: A chef is a professional cook, especially the head cook of a kitchen.

clue.text: Man has farewell to utter with resignation

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
ave is a Latin greeting and farewell

explanation.surface: A man says goodbye with a resigned sigh.
explanation.definitionFit: To heave a sigh is to let it out wearily, so the verb means to utter with resignation.

clue.text: Choosing absorbing time at work

indicators.note: absorbing means the first word takes in the second, which sits inside it

parts.note: opting means choosing
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone picks a job that soaks up all their hours at work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'absorbing' reads as gripping, but here it is the container signal: the period of time is taken in.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that is operating is working, so the word means at work or in action.

clue.text: Diamonds in reserve

explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link between the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Ice is slang for diamonds and also means a cold, reserved manner.

clue.text: Boxer has to move quickly -— this has great importance

parts.note: to fly is to move quickly
weight means importance, as in carrying weight

explanation.surface: A boxer must be quick on his feet, and this matters a great deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A flyweight is a boxer in the lightest weight division, so the word names a kind of boxer.

clue.text: Kind of shirt, blue, brought back and hung out

indicators.note: brought back means the joined pieces are read from right to left

parts.note: a T-shirt is a kind of shirt
blue can mean rude or lewd, as in a blue joke

explanation.surface: Someone retrieves a blue shirt and hangs it on the washing line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought back' turns TLEWD into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To hang out somewhere is informally to live or stay there, as dwelt means lived.
